name: Google Compute Engine
line: Create virtual machines and manage their operating systems and apps.

free.text: One e2-micro VM, 30 GB disk and 1 GB outbound monthly in eligible US regions

cells.regions: Iowa example; selectable Google Cloud regions

work.math: A VM for 730 hours, plus a 20 GiB disk, plus an IPv4 address, plus 100 GB of data sent out to North America (NA). Assumes the account's 1 GiB of free data sent out remains. Before tax and domain costs.
An e2-medium VM for 730 hours, plus a 20 GiB disk, plus an IPv4 address, plus 100 GB of North America (NA) data sent out. Assumes the account's 1 GiB allowance is unused. Before tax.
The known VM, disk, IP address and data sent out subtotal is $42.165032595. The daily 7-day backup snapshot and storage cost is not included and is unknown.
